log-rank χ² = 1,596 (1 df) · p < 1e-300 · stratified by study, 2 strata · pooled p < 1e-300
OS from each study's own baseline (left truncation applies; baselines are NOT harmonized across studies) Status '0:...' treated as censored. The log-rank test
is STRATIFIED by study (2 strata contributed events): each study is compared only against itself, so a difference in case mix between studies cannot
masquerade as a difference between cohorts. The pooled p is shown alongside — where the two disagree, the stratified one is the honest answer. Every site
contributes only (months, event, n) counts; no patient-level survival time crosses an instance boundary.
